name: RSS Reels
summary:
RSS Reels lets you add and manage your favorite RSS feeds, then browse articles in a stylish reel layout or a traditional feed list.

- Add any RSS feed URL
- Home screen shows full-screen article reels
- Feed screen shows a fast list view
- Filter articles by category
- Open articles in your browser
- Supports Japanese and English

Perfect for news, blogs, tech updates, and hobby sites — build your own personalized content stream.
